orders.summary:
I judged candidate assembled-2811 (round 27, R05, authored neck column) against baseline assembled-2775 and wrote no files.

**R05 (neck and shoulders), better but no result changes.**
- The side view now flows smoothly from the back of the head into the neck. The baseline's notch at the nape is gone, leaving only a faint angle.
- The front and rear necks are unchanged and still read as a tight hourglass stem, so R05.4 stays fail. I wavered between fail and partial and took the lower, as the brief requires.
- The shoulders were not touched. R05.5 stays partial and R05.6 stays fail.
- Audit row 7 is not resolved: the square deltoid caps, the disc on the upper back and the dark notches at the shoulder corners all remain.
- The measured criteria R05.1 to R05.3 still pass. Neck width went from 1.069 to 1.04 of the sheet and neck depth from 1.083 to 1.057.

**R12 (whole model), no visible change.** Results stay at fail, fail, fail, partial, partial, matching the baseline.

**Invariants.** All hold except I05 (tail tips curl up and out), which was already open in the baseline. The tail images did not change, so it is the same, not worse. I09 passes at 1.8543 against 1.8605.

**Other measured results.** These failures carry over unchanged from the baseline: R06.10, R07.6, R08.10, R08.11, R09.9 and R10.2.

The largest R05 problem left is in the shoulders, which need a body-step fix (B-19r) rather than another neck join.

reusable.what: Authored neck column: a table of sheet-derived rows (z, half, front, back, exp, wFront, wSide, wBack) plus fade, residualFade, smooth, jawFillet, baseFillet. It morphs head and body vertices in the table's z window onto the section and builds the bridge loft from the authored section plus decaying stub residuals. Without it the output is byte-identical to the original assembler.

Sweepable scalars. back-fill is a world y offset added to the table back edge, positive toward the head nape, ramped in over z .43 to .465. exponent multiplies the superellipse exponents (above 1 boxier). max-shift caps any vertex move, linear to 75 percent, then saturating.
Writes a neck table (specs/neck-r27-v*.json) from the sheet rows. jawFillet and baseFillet are Gaussian radii in world units that open the jaw-to-neck and base curvature.

reusable.option: recipe.py set <recipe> <out> J --flag value | J script <path>
reusable.what: Edits the assembly step's join args, or points it at a versioned assembler copy (assembly `script`, followed by the assembly key, pins and loop_tools assemble --assembler). A plan or sweep can set join parameters this way.
Records the table sha, morph counts and, per row, target against achieved half width, front and back in the final mesh.
